records.source: I finished writing my book, and it ended up being a mystery novel! Remember when you told me you were into mystery?$h#$b#Behold, '%book', a thrilling tale of deception and intrigue!$u#$b#I -almost- feel like I should split the profits with you, considering how much help you gave me!$h
records.translation: Natapos ko nang isulat ang aklat ko, at naging nobelang misteryo ito! Naaalala mo noong sinabi mong mahilig ka sa misteryo?$h#$b#Masdan mo, '%book', isang kapana-panabik na kuwento ng panlilinlang at intriga!$u#$b#-Halos- pakiramdam ko'y dapat kong ibahagi sa iyo ang kita, dahil napakalaki ng naitulong mo sa akin!$h

records.source: I finished writing my book, and it ended up being a romance novel! ...You told me once that you enjoyed the genre, and, well, I've also been able to draw some inspiration from real life experiences lately. $l#$b#Here it is, '%book'. It's about a train stewardess who falls in love with a traveling architect... but he's secretly engaged to the ticket collector's daughter!#$b#I *almost* feel like I should split the profits with you, considering how much help you gave me!$h
records.translation: Natapos ko nang isulat ang aklat ko, at naging nobelang romantiko ito! ...Minsan mong sinabi na nagustuhan mo ang genre, at, aba, nakahugot din ako ng inspirasyon mula sa mga tunay na karanasan nitong mga huling araw. $l#$b#Narito, '%book'. Tungkol ito sa isang tagapangasiwa ng tren na umibig sa isang naglalakbay na arkitekto... ngunit lihim siyang nakatakdang pakasal sa anak na babae ng tagasingil ng tiket!#$b#*Halos* pakiramdam ko'y dapat kong ibahagi sa iyo ang kita, dahil napakalaki ng naitulong mo sa akin!$h

records.source: I finished writing my book, and it's a sci-fi novel! Remember when you told me you were a fan of sci-fi?$h#$b#Behold, '%book'. It's about a boy who forms a symbiotic partnership with a semi-telepathic lifeform. Together they unravel the dark mysteries of an interstellar cabal.$u#$b#I -almost- feel like I should split the profits with you, considering how much help you gave me!$h
records.translation: Natapos ko nang isulat ang aklat ko, at isa itong nobelang kathang-agham! Naaalala mo noong sinabi mong mahilig ka sa kathang-agham?$h#$b#Masdan mo, '%book'. Tungkol ito sa isang batang bumuo ng simbiotikong ugnayan sa isang anyo ng buhay na bahagyang telepatiko. Magkasama nilang binubunyag ang madidilim na misteryo ng isang lihim na pangkat sa pagitan ng mga bituin.$u#$b#-Halos- pakiramdam ko'y dapat kong ibahagi sa iyo ang kita, dahil napakalaki ng naitulong mo sa akin!$h

records.source: I finished writing my book! $h#$b#Well, here it is... '%book'. It's about a government land surveyor who visits a tiny, isolated mining community... and discovers some disturbing secrets.$u#$b#I -almost- feel like I should split the profits with you, considering how much help you gave me!$h
records.translation: Natapos ko nang isulat ang aklat ko! $h#$b#Narito na... '%book'. Tungkol ito sa isang tagasukat ng lupa para sa pamahalaan na bumisita sa isang maliit at liblib na pamayanang minero... at nakatuklas ng ilang nakababahalang lihim.$u#$b#-Halos- pakiramdam ko'y dapat kong ibahagi sa iyo ang kita, dahil napakalaki ng naitulong mo sa akin!$h

records.source: The farm hasn't changed much all that much since we last spoke... but that's okay.#$b#If you're enjoying your new life, that's all that matters to me...#$b#I must return to the other world, now... but feel free to call on me again when you're ready.
records.translation: Hindi gaanong nagbago ang bukid mula noong huli tayong nag-usap... ngunit ayos lang iyon.#$b#Kung nasisiyahan ka sa bago mong buhay, iyon lang ang mahalaga sa akin...#$b#Kailangan ko nang bumalik sa kabilang daigdig... ngunit tawagin mo lamang akong muli kapag handa ka na.

records.source: You've done a good job improving the place since we last spoke.#$b#It seems you've tried your best... that's all I can ask for. I'm proud of you.#$b#I must return to the other world, now... but feel free to call on me again when you're ready.
records.translation: Mahusay ang ginawa mong pagpapaunlad sa lugar mula noong huli tayong nag-usap.#$b#Mukhang ginawa mo ang lahat ng makakaya mo... iyon lang ang mahihiling ko. Ipinagmamalaki kita.#$b#Kailangan ko nang bumalik sa kabilang daigdig... ngunit tawagin mo lamang akong muli kapag handa ka na.

records.source: You've done well, my boy.^You've done well, my dear.#$b#%farm Farm has never looked better. It's an honor to the family name.#$b#Grandpa is pleased.#$b#I must return to the other world, now... but feel free to call on me again when you're ready.
records.translation: Napakahusay ng ginawa mo, anak ko.^Napakahusay ng ginawa mo, mahal ko.#$b#Hindi kailanman naging ganito kaganda ang %farm Farm. Nagbigay ito ng malaking karangalan sa pangalan ng pamilya.#$b#Natutuwa si Lolo.#$b#Kailangan ko nang bumalik sa kabilang daigdig... ngunit tawagin mo lamang akong muli kapag handa ka na.
records.englishResidueReason: The engine substitution requires the literal compound '%farm Farm'; changing Farm breaks the generated farm name.

records.source: I'm so proud of you, my boy!^I'm so proud of you, my dear!#$b#You've really turned the place around since we last spoke!#$b#You're a better farmer than I ever was, and you've brought great honor to the family name.#$b#I can feel it now... My spirit is finally put to rest. Bless you.
records.translation: Ipinagmamalaki kita, anak ko!^Ipinagmamalaki kita, mahal ko!#$b#Talagang napabuti mo ang lugar mula noong huli tayong nag-usap!#$b#Mas mahusay kang magsasaka kaysa sa akin noon, at nagdala ka ng malaking karangalan sa pangalan ng pamilya.#$b#Nararamdaman ko na... Sa wakas, mapayapa na ang aking espiritu. Pagpalain ka.

records.source: The farm hasn't changed much in these past few years... but that's okay.#$b#If you're enjoying your new life, that's all that matters to me...
records.translation: Hindi gaanong nagbago ang bukid nitong mga nakaraang taon... ngunit ayos lang iyon.#$b#Kung nasisiyahan ka sa bago mong buhay, iyon lang ang mahalaga sa akin...
